You take the register, I take the grinder, and we meet in the middle.

Our morning rush is a relay race. You run the first leg.
I already warmed the cups. Warm cups, warm welcomes.

Keep the milk cold, the counter clean, and the music soft.

New hire, meet the grinder. Grinder, meet your new best friend.
